messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Ond' | causal conjunction (“wherefore”) | அதனால் | therefore | OK | | io | 1st‑person singular pronoun (subject) | நான் | I | OK | | per | preposition marking benefactive purpose | நலனுக்காக | for the good | OK | | lo | neuter definite article (the) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | tuo | 2nd‑person possessive adjective (thy) | உன் | your | OK | | me' | abstract noun “best” (the addressee’s good) | நலன் | good, benefit | OK | | penso | verb “think” (cognitive) | நினைத்து | thinking | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | மற்றும் | and | OK | | discerno | verb “deem, judge” (evaluative) | தீர்மானிக்கிறேன் | decide/judge | OK | | che | subordinating conjunction “that” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | tu | 2nd‑person pronoun (subject) | நீ | you | OK | | mi | 1st‑person pronoun (object) | என் | my (as object) | OK | | segui | verb “follow” (imperative‑like) | பின்பற்றுவாய் | you follow | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | மற்றும் | and | OK | | io | 1st‑person pronoun (subject) | நான் | I | OK | | sarò | future copular verb “will be” | இருப்பேன் | will be | OK | | tua | 2nd‑person possessive adjective (thy) | உன் | your | OK | | guida | noun “guide” (role) | வழிகாட்டியாக | as a guide | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | மற்றும் | and | OK | | trarrotti | future transitive verb “will lead you” | அழைத்துச் செல்லுவேன் | will lead (you) | OK | | di | preposition “from” (with *qui*) | இங்கிருந்து | from here | OK | | qui | adverb of place “here” (with *di*) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | per | preposition “to/through” (with *loco etterno*) | இடத்துக்கு | to (the) place | OK | | loco | noun “place” (archaic *luogo*) | இடம் | place | OK | | etterno | adjective “eternal” | நிரந்தர | eternal | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `lo`, `che`, `qui` – articles or conjunctions that have no direct equivalent in Tamil and are naturally omitted. - **All other items** are correctly rendered (**OK**). No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 112** - Original: அதனால் நான் உன் நலனுக்காக நினைத்து தீர்மானிக்கிறேன் - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 113** - Original: நீ என் பின்பற்றுவாய் மற்றும் நான் உன் வழிகாட்டியாக இருப்பேன், - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – missing object case marker for “me”. - Corrected: நீ **என்னை** பின்பற்றுவாய் மற்றும் நான் உன் வழிகாட்டியாக இருப்பேன்,
- **Line 114** - Original: நான் உன்னை இங்கிருந்து நிரந்தர இடத்துக்கு அழைத்துச் செல்லுவேன்; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` அதனால் நான் உன் நலனுக்காக நினைத்து தீர்மானிக்கிறேன் நீ என்னை பின்பற்றுவாய் மற்றும் நான் உன் வழிகாட்டியாக இருப்பேன், நான் உன்னை இங்கிருந்து நிரந்தர இடத்துக்கு அழைத்துச் செல்லுவேன்; ```
